verdict.rationale: Conta Simples is a corporate banking and expense SaaS, so choosing data region or residency is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions data storage location, region selection or residency controls. It covers only cards, payments, statements, categories, users and OAuth credential scopes, none of which concern where data is stored.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
